events.title: Clarence Valley Orchestra - An Afternoon at the Proms
events.description: The Clarence Valley Orchestra (CVO) is a prominent regional ensemble based in Grafton, New South Wales, Australia. Under the baton of its Artistic Director and Conductor, Dr Greg Butcher, the orchestra is celebrated for being high-quality, large-scale musical performance to regional and outback Australia, as well as taking local talent to the international stage. The CVO specialises in engaging "Pops" style program. These concerts feature a dynamic, accessible mix of timeless classical pieces, big band ad jazz hits, and show-stopping theatrical scores from Broadway and film, including music from West Side Story to Cabaret-style melodies. Having toured international as far as Italy, Slovenia, and Vienna, the 45-piece orchestra are now touring the Isle of Man, Ireland, and Scotland, with a busy concert tour, raising funds for local Rotary Clubs and other Charities along the way. A show not to be missed!

events.title: Wannabe - Spice Girls Tribute
events.description: Stop right now! Thank you very much. It’s time to Spice Up Your Life like it’s 1996. Relive the 90s through the hits of the Spice Girls on this Spice World journey; all you have to do is Say You’ll Be There. WANNABE is a concert-based musical designed for audiences to experience the thrill of a Spice Girls World Tour, packed with flares of the band’s history. With credits from London’s Westend to International tours, to date over 40 elite UK-based cast members have played iconic roles of Ginger, Sporty, Baby, Posh & Scary! Swing it, shake it, move it, make it down and if you think it’s all a bit Too Much, then really –Who Do You Think You Are?! So, if you Wannabe my lover, you’ve got to go and see this show! Experience Ginger, Scary, Sporty, Baby and Posh together on stage for a night where you can Zig-A-Zig-Ahhhh. Bring your moves, your outfits and your GIRL POWER! After opening in 2017 to rave reviews, WANNABE has toured the UK, Europe, Edinburgh Fringe Festival, Indonesia and Australia. Having played to over 200,000 Spice Girls fans, WANNABE is now the longest running Spice Girls stage show in the World. Featuring costumes inspired by poignant moments throughout the Spice Girls’ career, created specifically for this experience; and original musical arrangements, giving you the chance to hear your favourite songs in a fresh, exciting and unique way, exclusive to WANNABE. Expect your favourite hits including Wannabe, Stop, Say You’ll Be There, Who Do You Think You Are, Viva Forever, Too Much, Goodbye, Holler, 2 Become 1, Mama, Spice Up Your Life and some thrilling fan-favourite moments exclusive to the show. “Definitely a favourite nineties guilty pleasure everyone should enjoy!” ***** Raring2Go “Any true fan will jump from their seat” **** Theatre Weekly “A Vibrant Showstopper!” **** Theatre Weekly

events.title: An Evening with Bruce Mouat
events.description: An Evening with Bruce Mouat Bruce is 2-time Winter Olympic silver medallist, 2-time World champion, and 4-times European champion in curling. A sport that gripped the nation in 2022 and in 2026. Since both Olympic Games in Beijing and Milano Cortina, Curling has seen a boom in participation in the UK. In no small part to Bruce’s impressive skills as the team GB skip. As well as talking about Bruce’s achievements on the ice sheet, we will also talk about his life off it. In 2014 Bruce opened up about his sexuality to his teammates and now sees himself as a role model of the LGBTQ+ community, being one of only a handful of openly gay men in sport in Great Britain. In the 2nd half of the evening Bruce will answer questions submitted by the audience, which can be done on the night.

events.title: Step Into Christmas
events.description: Back for 2026, bigger and better, your Christmas starts here! Get ready to Step Into Christmas once again for the most magical, feel-good show of the year! After a sensational run, we’re back – bigger, brighter, and more festive than ever before. This spectacular Christmas concert is the ultimate way to kickstart your festive celebrations, guaranteed to fill your heart with holiday cheer and have you singing along from start to finish. Packed with all your favourite Christmas classics, the show brings the spirit of the season to life with dazzling performances, stunning festive visuals, and a sensational live band. From heartwarming ballads to upbeat festive anthems, it’s the perfect playlist for your Christmas celebrations. Whether you’re starting a new festive tradition or keeping the magic alive, Step Into Christmas is the ultimate feel-good Christmas spectacular.

events.title: West End Spectacular
events.description: The Ultimate Celebration of Musical Theatre Bring the thrill, power and excitement of London’s West End directly to your stage with West End Spectacular — a breathtaking live concert featuring six outstanding performers from some of the biggest musicals in the world. This electrifying evening celebrates the very best of musical theatre, performed by leading West End vocalists and musicians who have starred in global hit productions. Packed with iconic songs, soaring vocals and unforgettable moments, this is a show guaranteed to leave audiences cheering for more. From the first note to the final standing ovation, West End Spectacular delivers a night of pure theatrical magic. A Concert Event – Not Just a Tribute Show This is not a look-alike tribute. West End Spectacular features the real voices of the West End. Our exceptional cast have collectively performed in many of the world’s most celebrated productions including: Wicked • Les Misérables • The Phantom of the Opera • We Will Rock You • Mamma Mia! • Blood Brothers • Miss Saigon • Evita • Kinky Boots • Guys & Dolls • Hello Dolly • Fame • Mrs Doubtfire and many more. Expect an exhilarating journey through the greatest songs ever written for the stage — from powerhouse anthems and emotional ballads to uplifting crowd-pleasers that audiences know and love. An Unforgettable Night of Entertainment West End Spectacular is more than just a concert — it’s a full evening of entertainment. With a charismatic host guiding the audience through the show, the night is filled with humour, audience interaction and surprises, creating a fantastic atmosphere that keeps audiences engaged from start to finish. A Guaranteed Crowd-Pleaser Whether you are a lifelong musical theatre fan or simply love a great night out, West End Spectacular delivers hit after hit from the world’s most beloved shows. With its outstanding performers, spectacular vocals and feel-good energy, this is a show that leaves audiences uplifted, inspired and on their feet. West End Spectacular The songs you love. The voices of the West End. One unforgettable night of musical theatre. “A fantastic musical feast for the eyes and ears… bringing the West End and Broadway to our doorsteps.” ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️Billy Hui – BBC Northwest “A spectacular evening celebrating the joy and talent of the West End… the passion, energy and pure expertise of those on stage led to a very well-deserved standing ovation.” ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️Katy Gilroy – Northwest End UK

events.title: Retro Night Featuring Retrospect
events.description: RS Promotions presents Retro Night featuring RETROSPECT It’s Party Time again, and it's also Black-Eye Friday, so come and enjoy a Christmas Party Night with the fabulous RETROSPECT, for an evening crammed with timeless soul & motown classics. Plus DJ Music playing all those 70s & 80s hits to make this a fab night out.

events.title: Vladimir & Anton - Live
events.description: Vladimir & Anton Jablokov return to the Isle of Man for one night only! Expect an unforgettable evening of breathtaking violin virtuosity, iconic melodies, and electrifying energy, featuring favourites such as Bella Ciao, Those Were The Days, Bohemian Rhapsody, Viva La Vida, and music from The Godfather and some festive favourites. Born into a family of musicians, brothers Vladimir and Anton began playing the violin at the age of five. While Anton followed a traditional classical path, Vladimir took a very different route. At just 19, he left for Ireland, only to find himself busking on the streets of Dublin. It was there, performing for passers-by, that he rediscovered his love for music on his own terms. What followed is a truly remarkable story: from the streets to major concert halls across Europe, culminating in headlining Dublin’s iconic 3Arena for three consecutive years. Now reunited on stage, Vladimir & Anton bring their shared history, natural chemistry, and world-class musicianship to life in a performance that is both powerful and deeply personal. The beautiful and intimate setting of the Gaiety Theatre offers a rare opportunity to experience them up close with a special meet & greet after the show. A night of music, passion, and an extraordinary story you won’t want to miss. Line-up Vladimir Jablokov - Violin Anton Jablokov - Violin Adam Kuruc – Piano Peter Vizvari - Double Bass

events.title: Hans Zimmer vs John Williams (Manx Youth Band & Manx Concert Brass)

The bands are pleased to be welcoming special guests The Lon Dhoo Male Voice Choir who will be joining them and performing on the night.

events.title: Manx Last Night of the Proms
events.description: Manx Youth Band and Manx Concert Brass are pleased to once again present a Manx Last Night Of The Proms at the Gaiety Theatre on Saturday 26th September. Fresh from his acclaimed performance as Sky Masterson in Guys and Dolls earlier this year, we are pleased to welcome Damian Kneale as our guest soloist for the evening. This evening promises something for everyone, both the more serious music lovers and those who simply enjoy the finale and need an excuse to dress up for the night.

events.title: Ruby Wax: Absolutely Famous
events.description: Ruby Wax: Absolutely Famous It's almost easier to say whom Ruby Wax DIDN'T meet, interview and coax fascinating insights from in her huge TV shows 'Ruby Wax Meets' and 'Full Wax'. Donald Trump, OJ Simpson, Pamela Anderson, Madonna and many more. Her provocative, abrasive, incomparable style was - just about - kept in check by lifelong friend and A-list producer, Clive Tulloh. Together live on stage they review clips from the extraordinary shows, tell scandalous stories never before heard - and take the audience along for the ride. Featuring Ruby Wax & Clive Tulloh. ★★★★ ‘Deeply thoughtful and resolutely frothy' The Times ★★★★ 'Fascinating' The Telegraph ★★★★ ArtsHub ★★★★★ 'Hilarious' Entertainment Focus

events.title: Jon Culshaw - Me, Myself & Others
events.description: Jon Culshaw is taking to the road with a brand-new show for 2027. Join the star of BBC Radio 4’s Dead Ringers as he takes you on a whistle stop tour through an array of famous voices in an evening of stand-up, stories, sketches, and song! Jon is one of Britain's most critically acclaimed impressionists, comedians and actors with television credits ranging from such classic comedy series such as Spitting Image, The Impressions Show, and Newzoids, through to Channel 4’s award winning docudrama Partygate. On stage, in addition to his hugely successful solo comedy tour Imposter Syndrome, in recent years Jon has also played to packed houses in the one man play Les Dawson: Flying High, the Dead Ringers 25th Anniversary Tour, and the iconic London Palladium pantomime. Book now to see one of the country’s most renowned and diverse performers live! ‘World class virtuoso’ **** - The Times ‘Breathlessly entertaining’ **** - Mail On Sunday ‘Culshaw wins rounds of delighted applause, time and again’ **** - The Telegraph ‘Every impression is spot on… there really is something for everyone’ ***** - Broadway Baby ‘Quite literally jaw-dropping impressions’ ***** - The Scots Reviewer ‘An excellently crafted show’ ***** - Bookmarks & Stages ‘Just brilliant… Don’t miss this!’ ***** - North West End ‘Hilarious… perfect comedy timing’ ***** - One4Review ‘A masterclass in clever comedy’ **** - Everything Theatre ‘A genius imitator… hilarious’ **** - The Student Newspaper ‘An epic showcase of Culshaw’s talents’ **** - Mix Up Theatre

events.title: Crown Ballet presents The Nutcracker
events.description: Crown Ballet® Presents The Nutcracker – An eternal season favourite of classical ballet, performed live on stage The Nutcracker- a charming and kind fairy tale is one of the jewels of Tchaikovsky's repertoire. Prepare to enter a magical new world – the nutcracker in this ballet may be a handsome prince in disguise. The original Christmas story is based on The Nutcracker and the Mouse King written by E.T.A. Hoffmann. It tells the story of Marie, a sad little girl, whose godfather, Drosselmeier, gives her a Nutcracker doll as a present on Christmas Eve. In her lively imagination it turns into a prince and the magic starts… This eternal seasonal favourite will be an unforgettable journey and an ideal introduction to audiences of any age to the magic that is classical ballet. A wonderful treat full of glitter for the whole family!

events.title: Crown Ballet Presents Swan Lake
events.description: Crown Ballet® Presents Swan Lake: The Magic of Classical Ballet – Performed Live on Stage Widely regarded as the most iconic ballet of all time, Swan Lake is a masterpiece of Tchaikovsky’s genius. Featuring some of the most memorable music and breath-taking choreography, this production brings to life a timeless tale of love, betrayal, and redemption. Swan Lake tells the captivating story of Odette, a beautiful princess cursed to live as a swan by day and a woman by night. When Prince Siegfried encounters a flock of swans while hunting, he is enchanted as one of them transforms into the lovely Odette. However, their love is tested when the devious Odile, who resembles Odette, threatens to destroy their bond. Will Siegfried’s love for Odette be powerful enough to break the curse? Filled with mystery, romance, and emotional depth, Swan Lake has captivated the hearts of audiences for generations and continues to be celebrated worldwide. A spellbinding evening of timeless beauty that will leave you with cherished memories long after the curtain falls!

events.title: Jason Fox - Embrace the Chaos
events.description: Some people are built to Embrace the Chaos. Jason Fox is one of them, having survived some of the most hostile outposts on earth as an elite operator, documentary maker and expedition leader. Following the huge success of his new theatre show Embrace The Chaos, Jason returns with brand-new dates for 2027. He will share a series of never-told-before stories, his close brushes with enemy gunmen, terrorist bomb makers and cartel leaders, while revealing his strategies for surviving — and thriving — in environments as life-threatening as the Arctic Circle and Afghan badlands. Though, as you’ll learn, nothing is as terrifying as the rogue celebrity on SAS: Who Dares Wins… Using the principles from his elite military operations, this show will help you reboot your thinking, rebalance your life, and push you beyond your comfort zone. Challenge your limits, change your habits, and transform your life with this brand-new show. Includes Q & A.

events.title: Robert Arkins Commitments
events.description: The original Lead Star of award-winning Irish film 'The Commitments', the man who played Band Manager Jimmy Rabbitte, Robert Arkins, is on tour celebrating the 35th Anniversary of the Alan Parker movie classic, with his own 9-piece Commitments band direct from Dublin. Playing all the hits from the film including 'Mustang Sally, Nowhere To Run, Try A Little Tenderness, Midnight Hour, Destination Anywhere and much more as well as select cuts from the Detroit Soul and Northern Soul era from the likes of Jackie Shane and Eddie Floyd. Prepare for a night of none stop dancing. Now say it once and say it loud... Support comes from Dublin DJ Jacqui Carroll playing all the best Soul and Motown before and after the show

events.title: An Evening with Everton Legends - Peter Reid & Graeme Sharp
events.description: EVERTON LEGENDS - Graeme Sharp and Peter Reid The dynamic duo lead us through their illustrious careers, providing never-before revealed insights into what it’s like to play for Everton Football Club. These two legendary Toffees heroes share their incredible experiences, from iconic matches to behind-the-scenes stories, offering fans a unique insight into the club’s greatest moments. From winning the First Division to triumphing in the European Cup Winners’ Cup final, Graeme’s ten seasons at Goodison made him a club legend, featuring in the Greatest Ever Team poll celebrating the club’s 125 anniversary. Plus Peter Reid played a vital role in one of the club’s most successful periods – leading on to subsequent multi-club managerial experiences. Prepare for an enthralling evening. Expect a night filled with fascinating anecdotes, career highlights, and reflections on the highs and lows of professional football, and personal stories from the dressing room, this event promises to be an unforgettable experience – not only for every Everton supporter, but football fans across the island.

events.title: Jimeoin: Ballyhoo
events.description: A not-to-be-missed, hilarious evening with a genuine stand-up comedy legend who is globally hailed as one of live comedy's masters - we are absolutely delighted to welcome our favourite Irishman from Australia to the Gaiety Theatre with his sublimely funny new tour ‘Jimeoin - Ballyhoo!’ Jimeoin’s cheeky no-gimmicks sense of humour, superb material and broad appeal keeps audiences in stitches across the globe. You might be one of the hundreds of millions of fans who have viewed his online comedy clips, or perhaps you’ve seen his laugh-out-loud TV appearances on ‘Live at the Apollo’ or ‘The Royal Variety Performance’... but NOTHING beats seeing this observational joke-maestro on fire and in his element – live-on-stage! For a guaranteed fun-packed night out of great craic and great jokes we recommend you book early! ‘At the top of his game… didn't leave a dry eye in the house.’★★★★★ Manchester Evening News ‘A comic dynamo… exemplary stand-up comedy.’★★★★★ The Herald, Glasgow ‘Hilarious… It gets no better than this!’Time Out, London ‘Don’t miss it! events.title: An Evening with Toyah: Songs & Stories
events.description: An Intimate Evening With… A singer and actor, a TV host and author, a multiple BRIT Award nominee and a film star – Toyah has worn many hats during a remarkable career spanning more than 50 years. The High Priestess of Punk burst onto the scene in 1976 as she forged dual careers as a musician and actress who featured at The National Theatre and London’s Royal Court. Her role in Quadrophenia made her a household name and soon after she gatecrashed the charts with It’s A Mystery, I Want To Be Free, and Thunder In The Mountains, as the album, Anthem, earned a gold disc and BRIT nominations for Best Female and British Breakthrough Act. She married King Crimson guitarist Robert Fripp in 1986 and she starred opposite Sir Laurence Olivier and The Who’s Roger Daltrey, among others. Acting, presenting, performing, headlining tours, and releasing 16 studio albums continued her unique story and now it’s time to reflect. With a new book in the offing, Toyah is hitting the road for an extensive UK tour in which she’ll sing favourite hits and tell stories from her remarkable career.

events.title: Fred Dinenage's Ronnie, Reggie, and Me
events.description: The definitive insight into the real lives of Britain’s most notorious gangsters. For decades, they ruled the London underworld with fear and violence. But in 1969, the reign of Ronnie Kray and Reggie Kray came crashing down when both were sentenced to life imprisonment at the Old Bailey. Reggie would spend years behind bars in some of Britain’s toughest prisons, while Ronnie was confined to Broadmoor, his mental illness controlled only by heavy medication. Chosen by the twins themselves to tell their official story, TV legend Fred Dinenage became one of the very few people ever granted access to their inner circle - gaining extraordinary insight into the real lives behind the headlines. Now appearing live on stage, Fred Dinenage shares untold stories and rare moments never revealed before - including recordings made during his visits to Ronnie at Broadmoor. Hosted by broadcaster Alex Dyke, this gripping show brings you closer than ever to two of the most feared figures in criminal history - men other journalists could never get near. Hear first-hand what it was like to step inside Britain’s most formidable institutions, and uncover the gritty reality of gangland life in 1960s London - told by the only man they trusted.

events.title: Ricky Tomlinson - Retirement My Ar*e (with Asa Murphy)
events.description: Join us for an intimate and inspiring evening with one of Britain’s most recognisable and beloved entertainers. In this special event, Ricky Tomlinson opens up about the remarkable journey that shaped him—long before his rise to television fame. Ricky begins by reflecting on his early life in Liverpool: a childhood of working-class grit, humour, and resilience. He shares vivid stories of the city that raised him, the jobs that shaped his outlook, and the strong community spirit that forged his character. From his formative years as a plasterer to becoming an active trade unionist, Ricky speaks candidly about the political convictions that led him to stand up for workers’ rights—passionately, loudly, and at great personal cost. His moving account of the 1970s building workers’ strike and the trials that followed reveals the depth of his principles, as well as the lifelong impact of those turbulent years. With his trademark warmth and wit, Ricky then guides audiences through his unexpected path into show business. From small roles and early struggles to his breakthrough as Bobby Grant in Brookside, he charts the twists of fate that eventually led him to national fame. His tales from the set of The Royle Family, where he became a household name as the unforgettable Jim Royle, are both hilarious and heartfelt. Ricky’s natural storytelling brings to life the friendships, challenges, and creative magic that made the series one of Britain’s most cherished sitcoms. This special interview is hosted by writer and award-winning performer Asa Murphy, whose warm rapport and charismatic style bring out the very best in Ricky’s stories. “An Evening with Ricky Tomlinson” is more than an autobiography—it’s a celebration of honesty, humour, and humanity.

events.title: Paul Smith - Happy
events.description: Attention comedy fans worldwide! Paul Smith is hitting the road again with his brand-new tour HAPPY and this is the biggest, boldest show of his career. Following sold-out runs and viral success across the globe, HAPPY takes Paul’s trademark crowd work, razor-sharp observations, and laugh-out-loud true stories to an entirely new level. This is stand-up at full throttle: fast, fearless, and relentlessly funny. Packed with outrageous audience interaction and stories pulled straight from real life, HAPPY is a show about finding joy in the chaos, laughter in the everyday, and comedy in absolutely everything. Expect jaw-aching laughs from the first minute to the last. This is Paul Smith’s biggest tour ever, spanning the UK, Ireland, Europe, North America, Australia and New Zealand and tickets will go fast. If you like your comedy raw, real, and uncontrollably funny… HAPPY is the show you don’t want to miss.

events.title: Hello Again - The Neil Diamond Songbook
events.description: A brand new, mind-blowing production for 2027. Introducing a sensational new lead Jessie Rivers - celebrating 60 years of sparkling Neil Diamond hits. In 1966, prolific singer/songwriter Neil Diamond release his debut album The Feel of Neil Diamond, and music was changed forever. This five-star production is the world's greatest celebration and tribute to his life and work.

events.title: In Conversation with Suzy Eddie Izzard
events.description: The Isle of Man Arts Council Annual Lecture presents "In Conversation with Suzy Eddie Izzard". As part of their annual lecture series, the Isle of Man Arts Council are proud to announce an evening of conversation with one of Britain's most legendary and innovative comedians, Suzy Eddie Izzard. One of the most celebrated comics of her generation since the early nineties, Suzy Eddie Izzard has an equally stellar reputation as a film, television, and stage actor. The lecture will give the audience a look into the life of Suzy as a multi-faceted creative, and will include the opportunity for the audience to ask questions directly.

events.title: Roy Chubby Brown - It's Only Comedy
events.description: HE'S BACK! After well over 50 years in entertainment Roy " Chubby Brown" is still the undoubted undisputed KING OF BRITISH COMEDY. "Why is Roy still performing at his age?" is a question constantly asked but the answer is quite simple; nothing gives Roy greater pleasure than performing for you, doing what he does best, making you laugh and putting a huge smile on your faces. Roy has no plans to retire but the reality is nothing lasts forever so don't miss out! Come and join him for what could possibly be his last ever Isle Of Man performance. Whether your one of Roy's regular army of fans, a Chubby virgin, or just turned 18 and now old enough, come along for his brand new 2027 show. It's guaranteed the only tears you'll shed will be tears of laughter, it's a must see, a night not to be missed. NO OFFENCE MEANT IT'S SIMPLY COMEDY

events.title: Emma Kenny's - Murderous Minds
events.description: Emma Kenny, the nation’s trusted expert on criminal psychology, is embarking on a brand-new live tour with Murderous Minds—a captivating show delving into the most notorious British murder cases of our time. Emma has already wowed audiences with two sell out shows ‘The serial killer Next Door’ and ‘Killer Couples’. Murderous Minds isn’t just a retelling of crimes—it’s an unflinching journey into the psyche of killers, exploring the dark motives and life circumstances that led them to commit unthinkable acts. Known for her work dissecting real-life cases on platforms like ITV’s This Morning and her popular YouTube channel, Emma brings her unique ability to balance chilling facts with compassionate storytelling, ensuring the audience leaves informed, fascinated, and questioning everything they thought they knew about human nature. Emma has over one million’s subscribers to her YouTube and Facebook and has appeared on over 100 TV shows. Emma Kenny outsells all other crime commentators in the UK, she is a household name, a trusted source and a digital influencer with a reach unlike any other qualified commentator in the UK.

events.title: The D-Day Darlings - A Christmas to Remember
events.description: Following the success of their Victorious UK tour, Britain's Got Talent finalists, The D-Day Darlings, return direct from the Royal Albert Hall with their brand-new festive spectacular, A Christmas to Remember - bigger, more magical and more heartwarming than ever. Fronted by founder and lead singer Katie Ashby, the Darlings bring their signature heartfelt harmonies to a sparkling collection of festive favourites, including White Christmas, Winter Wonderland, Jingle Bells and It's The Most Wonderful Time of the Year. Featuring brand new music from their Christmas 2026 album, including their original song Here Comes Christmas Again, the show blends fresh material with timeless classics to create a truly memorable festive experience. With selected performances featuring the D-Day Juniors and Voices Choir, alongside dazzling costumes, elegant staging and uplifting choreography, this is a spine-tingling Christmas celebration for all the family.

events.title: An Audience with Footballing Icon Duncan Ferguson
events.description: HC Promotions proudly sponsored by Get the Ticket present an Audience with footballing icon Duncan Ferguson at The Gaiety Theatre, Isle of Man in Feb 2026. He began his career at Dundee United in 1990 and moved to Rangers in 1993 for what was then a British transfer record fee. He spent the remainder of his career in England, moving to Everton in 1994 before a stint with Newcastle United between 1998 and 2000, after which he returned to Everton, where he retired in 2006. During his career, Ferguson won the FA Cup with Everton in 1995. He was capped for Scotland seven times, playing at UEFA Euro 1992, but made himself unavailable for selection for the national team from 1997 due to a dispute with the Scottish Football Association. He has scored more goals than any other Scottish player in England’s Premier League since its creation in 1992. Ferguson’s aggressive style of play resulted in a career total of nine red cards, as well as a three-month prison sentence following an on-field assault of Raith Rovers’ John McStay in 1994. Eight of those red cards were in the English Premier League, where he holds the joint record for dismissals alongside Patrick Vieira and Richard Dunne. He is known by the nicknames “Big Dunc” and “Duncan Disorderly”. Hear from Big Dunc himself live and unscripted telling tales from on and off the field. On the night you can also expect a live auction of sporting memorabilia.

events.title: An Evening with Liverpool Legend John Barnes
events.description: A Night Every Liverpool Fan Will Remember! Step into the incredible world of one of Liverpool Football Club's greatest ever players as we present An Evening with John Barnes. Widely regarded as one of the most gifted footballers of his generation, John thrilled the Anfield faithful for a decade, helping Liverpool dominate English football and achieve unforgettable success on the European stage. During his illustrious career with the Reds, he won two League Championships, two FA Cups, a League Cup, and the 1992 UEFA Super Cup, while also playing a key role in Liverpool's memorable European campaigns. Now's your chance to hear the stories behind the trophies, the dressing room, the rivalries, the unforgettable nights under the Anfield lights, and the characters who made Liverpool one of the greatest teams in world football. Whether you witnessed John Barnes in his prime or simply want to hear from one of football's true icons, this promises to be an unforgettable evening full of humour, emotion, and incredible football memories. Come join us for an unforgettable evening with one of Liverpool's greatest ever legends. You'll Never Walk Alone. It’s a must-attend evening for Liverpool supporters and football fans alike.

events.title: The Legends of American Country Show
events.description: THE LEGENDS OF AMERICAN COUNTRY SHOW RETURNS TO THUNDEROUS APPLAUSE ACROSS EUROPE! Europe’s No.1 Country Music Tribute Show Celebrates Unstoppable Success with over 350,000 Fans and 2,000 Five-Star Reviews Prepare for a boot-stomping, heart-thumping journey through the golden age of country music! The Legends of American Country Show, Europe’s most celebrated tribute to classic and contemporary country stars, continues to dazzle audiences across the continent. This award-winning production has been hailed as the Best Country Tribute Show, captivating over350,000 fans and racking up more than 2,000 five-star reviews along the way. Featuring stunning renditions of legendary hits from Dolly Parton, Johnny Cash, Willie Nelson, Tammy Wynette, Kenny Rogers, Hank Williams, Garth Brooks, Shania Twain, Alan Jackson, Luke Combs, and many more, this unforgettable night of music brings Nashville to life like never before. The show delivers a dazzling mix of powerful vocals, authentic costumes, and first-class musicianship, backed by a stellar live band and spectacular lighting and visuals. Whether you're a lifelong country fan or a newcomer to the genre, The Legends of American Country Show promises to transport you to the heart of Nashville and back in one magical night. Let us take you to Nashville and back in one night! Don’t miss your chance to experience the songs, the stories, and the soul of true American country legends — all performed live in one incredible show. “As good as Country show that you will see live anywhere outside Nashville” - Country Music Northern Ireland “Pure Raw Country at its Best” - CMT “Fantastic show of nostalgic country at its best with superb vocalists and musicians” - Hot Country TV

events.title: The Roy Orbison Story
events.description: Celebrate 70 Platinum Years of iconic hits Barry Steele and Friends – The Definitive Roy Orbison Concert Experience If you want the real deal, the name on the ticket is Barry Steele. Direct from the West End’s Adelphi Theatre and celebrating 21 years in the business, Barry Steele’s Roy Orbison Story takes you on a fantastic musical journey celebrating the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame legend and six-time Grammy-winning Roy “The Big O” Orbison, along with his iconic friends in the music world. Backed by a superb 5-piece band, this show transports you from the rockabilly Sun Records era right through to the Traveling Wilburys, delivering all the classic hits including “Pretty Woman,” “Crying,” “I Drove All Night,” “You Got It,” “Only the Lonely,” “In Dreams,” “California Blue,” “Rattled,” and “Handle with Care,” plus many more. Don’t miss one of the biggest nights of the year as this exceptionally talented cast recreates the magic, energy, and quality of Roy Orbison’s music. As The Stage says: “True Identikit Brilliance.” Experience the Platinum Years – a night to remember.

events.title: Mighty Music from Stage & Screen - with Kevin Grunill
events.description: A musical evening celebrating popular film music from the silver screen of Hollywood to the Broadway & West End stage musicals, showcasing our very own ‘Mighty’ Wurlitzer theatre organ in the Villa Arcade. Celebrated Theatre Organist - Kevin Grunill makes a return visit to the Villa Arcade to present a one-off show featuring some of the wonderful music from Phantom of the Opera, 633 Squadron, The Wizard of Oz, Brassed Off, The Sound of Music, Titanic, Chitty Chitty Bang Bang, The Little Mermaid, Les Miserable & much more. Known for his award-winning performances at the North Pier & Tower Ballroom, Blackpool, Kevin now performs all over the U.K. and abroad on some of the World’s finest theatre organs, showcasing the very best of film and stage music. Kevin regularly performs at the Astoria Centre in Barnsley, where he also restores and maintains these fine theatre pipe organs, presenting weekly concerts and dances to the delight of audiences who travel far and wide to experience the thrilling sound of the ‘Mighty’ theatre organ.

events.title: An Audience with Lord Ian Botham
events.description: Lord Ian Botham, the former England captain, was one of the most impactful all-rounders of his generation with 14 centuries and 383 wickets in a career that spanned over 15 years. Through the 1980s, he was part of a golden generation of all-rounders in world cricket. The 1981 Ashes, which England won 3-1, have since come to be known as Botham’s Ashes for his starring performances with bat and ball. In 2007, Botham was knighted for his services to cricket and to charity. Prolific with both bat and ball, Ian Botham was the fastest to the double of 1000 runs and 100 wickets. He broke the World Record for most Test wickets, and finished his career with 5,200 runs and 383 wickets. Join Lord Ian, as he discusses his amazing career, and everything in between. Your host for the evening: Cricket legend Geoff Miller OBE

events.title: Fizz & Flicks: The Devil Wears Prada 2 - Exclusive Charity Screening
James Phelan - The Man Who Was Magic
events.description: Dare to believe in magic as the UK's #1 magic show returns with a completely new and uplifting production for 2025. You're invited to a night of wonder, as secrets unravel and the impossible becomes possible. Following an unprecedented 5 years of sold-out shows around the world - this five star magic show guarantees to leave you aching with laughter & dizzy in disbelief. Presented by world-renowned award-winning magician James Phelan, the first magician in history to sell out a solo-run at The Magic Circle - and most infamous for jamming the BBC switchboard after he correctly predicted the lottery. Don't miss what The Standard calls "An unforgettable evening we can't stop talking about". All new material for 2025. Tickets limited and will sell out quickly. ‘Joel Dommett meets David Blaine’ (The Sun) ‘Barely skips a beat. One to watch in the world of magic’ (The List) ★★★★★ ‘This isn’t a show for people who want to see magic on stage. This is for people who want to feel it’ (World Magic Review) ★★★★★ ‘One of the most endearing factors is seeing amazed faces young and old. This show has many moments like that’ (BBC Sounds) ★★★★★ ‘Magic is in his bones. Disbelief. Flabbergasted. Stunned’ (Henley Herald)

events.title: Queen of the Night - A Tribute to Whitney Houston
events.description: Queen of the Night – A Tribute to Whitney Houston returns in 2027 for another show-stopping celebration, following sold-out tours across the UK, including an arena tour and iconic venues such as the Royal Albert Hall and The London Palladium. Established as the UK’s biggest Whitney Houston tribute, this breath-taking production honours the music, legacy, and unmatched talent of the legendary Whitney Houston. Celebrate Whitney’s remarkable musical repertoire in an electrifying production that honours her timeless songs with sensational vocalists and a full live band. Prepare to be captivated by an extraordinary journey through three decades of all-time hits such as I Wanna Dance With Somebody, One Moment In Time, I’m Every Woman, I Will Always Love You, My Love Is Your Love, So Emotional, Run To You, Saving All My Love, How Will I Know, Million Dollar Bill, The Greatest Love Of All, and many more. Join us for an unmissable evening filled with live music, captivating choreography, and powerful vocals, as we pay homage to the one and only queen of the night. Please note that this is a tribute production not associated with the Estate of Whitney Houston.

events.title: Murder, She Didn't Write
events.description: Don your deerstalker, grab your magnifying glass and get your ‘finger of suspicion’ at the ready because Edinburgh Fringe favourites, Degrees of Error, are bringing back their multiple sell-out show for your sleuthing pleasure. They’ll create a classic murder mystery on-the-spot in this ingenious improvised comedy. You, the audience, become the author as the cast act out your very own Agatha Christie-inspired masterpiece live on stage. At each show this extraordinarily talented company use audience suggestions to create a unique, original and extremely comical murder mystery just for you. All you have to do... is solve it! Ms Gold poisoned at a synchronised swimming gala? Dr Blue exploded by cannon during a hot air balloon race? Professor Violet crushed to death at a Love Island recoupling? You decide! But will you guess whodunnit before the killer is revealed? ★★★★★ 'Outstanding performances delivered by a seriously talented cast!' (Three Weeks) ★★★★★ 'Absolutely fantastic... incredibly clever... laugh-out-loud funny... a truly entertaining and hilarious take on the murder mystery and absolutely not one to miss' (VoiceMag.uk) ★★★★★ 'Hilarious... the show is a riot' (Scottish Daily Mail) ★★★★★ 'by far the best improvised show I have ever seen!' (Inter: Mission) ★★★★★ 'a fully-fledged play that still leaves its audience gasping with shock when the truth is revealed' (North West End) ★★★★★ 'hilarious and an absolute must-see' (The Student Newspaper)

events.title: Russell Watson - The Power of the Voice
events.description: The UK's most celebrated tenor, Russell Watson, will return to the stage of the country's best-loved theatres next year for a new concert tour. He will bring a breath-taking new production of hits, operatic masterworks, and West End anthems to major theatres nationwide. The four-time Classical BRIT Award winner is currently on his most intimate tour, sharing songs and stories from his career to sell-out crowds. His next tour will see Russell's powerful vocals accompanied by a live orchestral ensemble in what will be a captivating stage show. The Power of The Voice Tour promises an evening spanning the full breadth of his career: from the immortal Italian arias that launched his rise ("Nessun Dorma," "Volare") to showstopping West End staples ("Music of the Night") and contemporary crossover hits. Russell said: "Performing in Britain's historic theatres holds a magic like nowhere else. The intimacy, the history, and the natural acoustics create a shared resonance between the stage and the audience. With 'The Power of The Voice Tour,' we are crafting a show tailored specifically for these stunning spaces - bold, emotive, and visually rich. I can't wait to share it with everyone."

events.title: Scott Bennett
events.description: As a society we love stuff, it’s a statement about who we are and who we want to be. But apparently, this message is at odds with the looming environmental crisis. We’re now struggling to balance these worlds, to focus on the things that bring us real connections and nourish the soul. Award-winning Comedian and Award-winning Product Designer, Scott Bennett is desperately trying to cleanse his life of stuff, but is this even possible anymore? Tour support for Micky Flanagan, Rob Brydon Jason Manford, and John Bishop. The star of Live at the Apollo, The News Quiz, The Now Show, The Ultimate Choice and Chortle Best Club Comedian Nominee 2022. “Without doubt live comedy’s best kept secret” - Evening Standard "Great material, great delivery, a very funny man" - Rob Brydon "Brilliantly funny, a joy to watch" - Chris Ramsey “Bennett is a stand-up in fine control of his material, his delivery and his image, a masterclass in adding a frisson of ‘in the moment’ unpredictability to otherwise tightly written routines” - **** Chortle

events.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
events.description: Set in a playful neo-Victorian world of worker bees, this inventive new production of The Importance of Being Earnest transforms Oscar Wilde's comedy into a thrilling feat of ensemble theatre. Six actor musicians perform every role through breath-taking doublings and inventive performance theatrics. Featuring original English parlour songs, handcrafted costumes, live music, and inventive stagecraft, no two performances are ever quite the same. Created through rehearsals in London and an artistic residency in rural Normandy, the production embraces the spirit of European repertory theatre: artists living, creating, and touring together as one company. Following its premier, the production embarks on an international tour of twelve countries and more than 150 performances, celebrating Wilde's wit with generosity, imagination, and infectious theatrical joy.

events.title: The Dusty Show
events.description: Welcome to The Dusty Show, The celebration of a true British pop icon. An unforgettable evening of wall-to-wall hits and classics spanning the success of Dusty Springfield’s life and music. Singer Louise Anne Masters takes you on a journey to remember, through the years of Dusty’s career with the utmost authenticity, grace, and a stunning vocal performance that is second to none. Accompanied by her 9-piece band, Louise takes you from the debut ‘I Only Want To Be With You’ and ‘Stay A While’ through to the ‘Ready Steady Go’ Motown era, Dusty in Memphis’ ‘Son Of A Preacher Man’, the psychedelic ‘Ain’t No Sun Since You Been Gone’ to the pinnacle ‘You Don’t Have To Say You Love Me’ and so many more. The Dusty Show is the ultimate definition of a musical legacy that touches the soul, and a life story that warms the heart. Join us in reminiscing with the very best tribute to our very own queen of British pop…

events.title: Makings of a Murderer - Fatal Mistake
events.description: They planned the murder. They covered their tracks. They thought they had got away with it. They almost did. In The Makings of a Murderer: Fatal Mistake, award-winning investigative journalist and broadcaster Donal MacIntyre examines the extraordinary true stories of killers who came terrifyingly close to escaping justice. These are the murderers who lied convincingly, destroyed evidence, created false alibis and, in some cases, remained free for years. But somewhere, something went wrong. A tiny forensic trace. A forgotten witness. A change in behaviour. A piece of CCTV. A phone call. A contradiction. One mistake that finally began to unravel everything. Drawing on some of the most compelling murder investigations of modern times, Donal takes audiences inside the hunt for killers who believed they had committed the perfect crime. How did they avoid suspicion for so long? What finally gave them away? And just how close did they really come to getting away with murder? Gripping, revealing and packed with extraordinary real-life cases, The Makings of a Murderer: Fatal Mistake explores the killers who nearly beat the system - and the investigators, evidence and chance discoveries that finally brought them to justice.

events.title: Scott Bennett - Stuff
events.description: As a society we love stuff, it’s a statement about who we are and who we want to be. But apparently, this message is at odds with the looming environmental crisis. We’re now struggling to balance these worlds, to focus on the things that bring us real connections and nourish the soul. Award-winning Comedian and Award-winning Product Designer, Scott Bennett is desperately trying to cleanse his life of stuff, but is this even possible anymore? Tour support for Micky Flanagan, Rob Brydon Jason Manford, and John Bishop. The star of Live at the Apollo, The News Quiz, The Now Show, The Ultimate Choice and Chortle Best Club Comedian Nominee 2022. “Without doubt live comedy’s best kept secret” - Evening Standard "Great material, great delivery, a very funny man" - Rob Brydon "Brilliantly funny, a joy to watch" - Chris Ramsey “Bennett is a stand-up in fine control of his material, his delivery and his image, a masterclass in adding a frisson of ‘in the moment’ unpredictability to otherwise tightly written routines” - **** Chortle

events.title: Dance Sounds of the 90s: The Live Tour with Vernon Kay (on sale 9/10/26 @ 10am)
Dance Sounds of the 90s: The Live Tour with Vernon Kay
Samwise #29 - A Tribute to Sam Naughton
events.description: Castletown man Sam Naughton was killed during practise for the 2026 MGP. He leaves his wife Charlotte and four young children: Bonnie, Liam, Jesse, and Parker. The aim is to raise as much as possible to make their lives just a little bit more bearable following the tragic loss of the love of Charlotte's life, and the kids' Dad. Featuring FOUR of the Island's best Tribute Bands, we are proud to give you: Balla Sabbath Bon Jelski Bad Reputation Pigs on the Wing All the bands are very generously giving their services completely free of charge. So, join us for a night of music and madness.

events.title: Ben Portsmouth: This is Elvis
events.description: Ben Portsmouth brings you his jaw-dropping tribute to the King of Rock ‘n’ Roll! With global success in over 20 countries including sellout performances on the same Vegas stage as Elvis, to London's West End, don’t miss Ben Portsmouth: This is Elvis, at the Alhambra Theatre. Making history in 2012, Ben broke records becoming the first European to be crowned by Elvis Presley Enterprises as the ‘Worldwide Ultimate Elvis Tribute Artist’ in Memphis, which swiftly followed with an invite to headline a special Elvis week on the Late Show with David Letterman. Celebrating the life of an iconic showman, Ben and the Taking Care of Elvis Band will take you on a trip down memory lane with many of Elvis' most loved songs from all eras including the 1950s, the iconic '68 Comeback Special, and Ben's personal favourite, the 1970s Vegas concerts. With his looks, charm and charisma, Ben is recognised as the world's leading Elvis tribute artist - he continues to amaze audiences with his stage presence, with fans globally claiming, 'this is the closest you will ever get to the King!'. Join us for a phenomenal evening with Ben and the Band on this worldwide tour!

events.title: A Wurlitzer Christmas Spectacular with the Cathedral Choir
events.description: Join Dr Peter Litman and the Cathedral Choir for an evening of fabulous sing-a-long Festive highlights, well known Carols, and all the descants you know!

events.title: Manxtoberfest - A Night of Brass, Beer, and Bavarian Mayhem
Conservation in Action: Stone and Scraa at Cregneash
events.description: Join us at Harry Kelly's Cottage in Cregneash for a behind-the-scenes look at the conservation work taking place on this historic cottage.

events.title: James B Partridge
events.description: Britain’s favourite music teacher, James B Partridge, is bringing his Primary School Bangers tour to the Gaiety Theatre on Saturday 24th October 2026! Get ready for a joy-filled, tongue-in-cheek trip back to your school days - packed with massive singalongs, throwback mash-ups, and all the assembly anthems to which you still somehow remember every word. From classroom covers to viral fame, Glastonbury singalongs to sold-out theatres, James has become the nation’s most feel-good live act - funny, heartfelt, and completely genuine. Gather your mates, colleagues or family for the ultimate nostalgic night out.

events.title: Ed Gamble's Comedy Pit Stop
events.description: VillaGaiety’s Comedy Pit Stop is returning with headliner Ed Gamble. Taking to the stage for one night only in the VillaGaiety’s Royal Hall, this exclusive stand up special is brought to you by VillaGaiety in partnership with Avalon Comedy, one of the UK’s leading live comedy producers. Following his extended and biggest UK and Ireland stand-up tour to date, which included five consecutive nights at London’s iconic Hackney Empire plus a sold-out performance at the London Palladium, award-winning comedian, co-host of the mega-hit podcast Off Menu with James Acaster, Taskmaster champion and host of both Taskmaster the Podcast and of The Traitors: Uncloaked, and judge on Great British Menu (BBC2), Ed Gamble is bringing his “eye-wateringly hilarious” (The I) comedy to the Isle of Man. Also seen and heard on Mock The Week (BBC2), Live At The Apollo (BBC), and on Sunday mornings on Radio X alongside Matthew Crosby. Kick start your TT with a blast of comedy and the perfect pit stop from the 2026 races.

events.title: The Doors Alive
events.description: "To call The Doors Alive merely a tribute act would be a huge disservice to what is the closest thing possible to experiencing a Doors concert without the aid of a flux capacitor and 1.21 gigawatts. They are high priests who allow us to worship at the altar of The Doors by continuing the word and gospels of Jim Morrison, Ray Manzarek, Robbie Krieger and John Densmore." - Pure Magazine, Ireland. The band recreate the sound, look, presence and magic of a real 1960's Doors concert, perfectly and effortlessly transporting the audience back in time with classic hits such as "Light My Fire", "When The Music's Over", "Riders On The Storm", "The End" and many more. The Doors Alive have over 1,000 shows under their belt to date. The Doors Alive formed in 2005. Since then there have been a few changes, but the current line-up is the best it has ever been! Frontman Mike Griffioen captures the look, attitude and rich baritone voice of the late great Jim Morrison with ease while his compadres Barrington Meyer on guitar, Buzz Allan on drums and Norbert Varga on keyboards showcase the musical chops of original Doors members Robby Krieger, John Densmore and Ray Manzarek with finesse and authenticity. They take pride in using the exact same vintage equipment to achieve an authentic sound, including Rhodes Piano Bass, Gibson G101 organ, Gibson SG and Ludwig Mod Orange drum kit. They are keen on making every single show unique by authentic improvisations and changing the set regularly so you will never see the same show twice! The Doors Alive have left awestruck audiences in several countries around the world, including the UK, Ireland, Australia, Denmark, France, Belgium, The Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Poland, Slovenia, Malta, Greece, Turkey, Lebanon, UAE and Chile to name but a few. They repeatedly sell out some of the most well-established venues in Europe. They have played at the legendary Isle of Wight Festival and played on the same bill with such legendary musicians as Status Quo, Canned Heat, Nazareth, Uriah Heep, Manfred Mann's Earth Band, Eric Burdon and Kris Kristofferson. In Chile the band played an arena show to 4,500 Doors fans! In several countries including France and Lebanon the band have been featured on national television.

events.title: The Drifters
events.description: The Drifters are back on tour in the UK performing all their classic hits including ‘Saturday Night at the Movies', ‘You’re More Than A Number,’ ‘Come on Over to My Place’, ‘Under the Boardwalk’, ‘Kissin’ In The Back Row’ and many more! The legendary group have been inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, performed for the President of the United States and listed among the Greatest Artists of All Time by Rolling Stone magazine. Under the guidance of Tina Treadwell (daughter of the group’s original founders, George & Faye Treadwell) The Drifters have enjoyed a remarkable resurgence in recent years with multiple successful UK tours including headline shows in major arenas and, most notably, the world famous Royal Albert Hall in London for the first ever time in the group’s glittering career. “I am thrilled with the success of our recent UK tours and we invite you all to join us in continuing to celebrate this incredible and everlasting story of The Drifters.” Said Tina, speaking about the tour.

events.title: The Signatures - Northern Soul Live
events.description: Northern Soul Live The UK’s most authentic Northern Soul Live Show! Experience the soul-stirring magic of The Signatures—the official backing band for many of the Northern Soul original artists as well as being featured as the house band for the Northern Soul special on The Craig Charles Funk and Soul Show on BBC 6 Music. Immerse yourself in the energy of a ten-piece live band, showcasing their exceptional talent in their own distinctive style. The Signatures, along with their power and expression, have worked with more original artists than any other band in the UK, delivering a truly authentic performance.

events.title: Jamie Webster
events.description: Jamie Webster has quickly become one of Britain’s defining voices of folk-inspired indie, not merely for his guitar and voice but for the way he stitches class, place and political disquiet into communal anthems. His third studio album, 10 For The People, followed two previous Top Ten UK albums – We Get By and Moments – and itself soared to No. 2 in the UK charts. Over the summer of 2024, Webster staged what many saw as his breakthrough live moment: playing Sefton Park for 32,000 people, and the first of two consecutive years at Glastonbury. His single ‘Breadline’, released shortly beforehand, renewed his reputation for balancing warm acoustics with sharp lyrics, and became one of the standout tracks on his 2025 Sefton Park live EP. 2026 marked a reflective new era for the Liverpudlian troubadour, with the announcement of his fourth album Running Round The Sun. A full tour in support of the album has now been revealed with dates stretching across the UK - including a stop in the Isle of Man on 25th September!

events.title: Pigs on the Wing
events.description: The island’s favourite (and only, it must be said) Pink Floyd tribute band, Pigs on the Wing, will be returning to The Gaiety Theatre on Friday 28th August 2026 to perform in full, Pink Floyd’s seminal, and era defining live album, P.U.L.S.E. The band members may have changed in the last 30 odd years, but the quality and attention to detail certainly haven’t. The 2026 line-up features founding member Pete Williamson on lead vocals and guitar, Richard (Dick) Raine on bass guitar, legendary percussionist Steve Leach on drums, Ian (Wrighty) Wright on keyboards, Kev Cleator on acoustic and electric guitars and last but not least, Alex Duke, who replaces our (still) good friend, Chris Honour on lead & slide guitars. Completing the full 9-piece band are husband and wife team, Jo and Juan Callister on backing vocals, the one and only Sammy Johnson on saxophone. High demand is expected, so get your tickets early and join Pigs on the Wing at The Gaiety Theatre on Friday 28th August for a great live show….. 31 years after the first gig, and still going from strength to strength. Re-live the glory days of Pink Floyd, one of the world’s greatest and best loved rock bands, with Pigs on the Wing, playing one of rock music’s greatest live albums ever, in the Island’s most iconic venue – The Gaiety Theatre.

events.title: The Cheap Thrills
events.description: A steady succession of self-released singles have seen The Cheap Thrills pricking up ears on both sides of the Atlantic, receiving support from BBC 6Music and Radio X, along with spins from Sirius XM and KX93.5 in the States, and high-profile Spotify playlisting in amongst the likes of ‘Hot New Bands’, ‘The Indie List’ and 'Proper Belters’. The single ‘Codependence’ proved a tearaway hit, and was selected to soundtrack Liverpool FC’s European kit campaign, reaching an audience of LFC fans worldwide. The second half of 2025 saw the band selling out 1500 tickets in less than 12 hours for their headline show at Liverpool’s Grand Central Dome, before heading out on a six-date UK tour with The Slow Readers Club ahead of returning to the studio to put the finishing touches to their debut album. A single, ‘Walton Vale’, was released just ahead of the Dome show, once again picking up support from the BBC and DSPs. The Cheap Thrills recently announced the launch of pre-sales of their debut album ‘Keep Cheap’ (to be released September 18th 2026), and the single ‘Hairs’, and their upcoming August 1st hometown headline show at Liverpool’s 2500 capacity Mountford Hall has been sold out for weeks. The band have slots at Nottingham’s Splendour Festival and Derbyshire’s Y Not across the summer, as well as supports with The Fratellis in Blackpool and Wakefield.

events.title: The Sound of Springsteen
events.description: RS Promotions is excited to bring The Sound of Springsteen to the island. Experience the pure rock'n'roll euphoria of Bruce Springsteen as this outstanding show brings his iconic sound to life, taking you on a musical journey through the incredible catalogue from Greetings from Ashbury Park to 2020's Ghosts via the legendary hits Born in the USA and Born to Run. From high-octane vocals to the phenomenal stage production, every detail is meticulously created to transport you back to the golden age of rock'n'roll. Whether you're a lifetime Springsteen fan or discovering his music for the first time, you will be captivated by the thundering guitars, iconic saxophone, and powerful lyrics that defined generations. Get ready to experience the musical legacy of THE BOSS!

events.title: Buddy Holly & The Cricketers
events.description: 35 Years of Rock ’n’ Rolling the World — on TV, Radio & in Venues Worldwide! For more than three decades, this sensational show has Rock ’n’ Rolled audiences on TV, radio and in theatres and outdoor venues across the globe — from Croydon to California, Barking to Bangkok and Swindon to Sweden. With standing ovations every night, it’s hard to imagine the show getting any better… but for 2027, it just has. The brand-new Rock ’n’ Roll Legends Show celebrates all of Buddy Holly’s best-loved songs, alongside the biggest hits from fellow 50s icons including Elvis Presley, Jerry Lee Lewis, Little Richard, Chuck Berry, Eddie Cochran, The Everly Brothers and Ray Charles. With 35 years of sell-out UK and international touring, Buddy Holly and The Cricketers has firmly established itself as the ultimate live rock ’n’ roll experience. Featuring five top actor-musicians, the show was endorsed as Britain’s most popular Buddy Holly act when the boys appeared on BBC One’s primetime entertainment show The One and Only, hosted by Graham Norton. Every night, this amazing show brings to life the songs parents danced to, grandparents fell in love to and families still cherish today. From Buddy’s timeless hits to the unmistakable voices of Elvis, Little Richard and The Everly Brothers, every number is performed with warmth, joy and the irresistible energy only live music can deliver. Children adore the show too — they’re often the first on their feet, and when they start dancing, the whole room follows. The Buddy Holly & The Cricketers Rock ’n’ Roll Legends Show is the ultimate night out for all ages. Whatever the season and whatever the excuse to celebrate, make your heartbeat a little faster with the show that has thousands of fans around the world saying: “I can’t believe it’s not Buddy!” “The audience were dancing in the aisles and roaring for more” - The Stage “Buddy brilliant!” - Graham Norton, BBC One “Fantastic...The best... tremendous night out...I can’t praise the show enough” - The Kent and Sussex Courier “Christmas just wouldn’t be Christmas without Buddy Holly and The Cricketers” - Somerset County Gazette ★★★★★- Ayr Gaiety Theatre

events.title: The Bon Jovi Experience
events.description: Relive the magic up close with the only show to be endorsed by Jon Bon Jovi himself. Direct from London’s West End, the show returns for its epic 33rd year, cementing its place as one of the UK’s longest-running tribute shows. Get ready to rock through an unforgettable journey with The Bon Jovi Experience – a phenomenal celebration of timeless classics, packed with the magic, passion, and energy of true stadium rock. The Bon Jovi Experience features smash-hits such as 'Livin’ On a Prayer,’ 'Always’, ‘It’s My Life‘, 'You Give Love a Bad Name‘, 'Bad Medicine‘ and many more. Backed by a powerhouse live band, charismatic front man, Tony Pearce, leads an authentic, high-energy show that will have you singing and dancing all night. Whether you’re a lifelong Bon Jovi fan or new to the music, this show promises an unforgettable experience. “The best Bon Jovi tribute band I’ve ever watched” - Jon Bon Jovi “Have you seen this guy? He’s so much like Jon Bon Jovi, it’s freaky man!” - Chad Kroeger, Nickelback “The Bon Jovi Experience are up there among the best” – Liverpool Echo News

events.title: Gabrielle: The Hits UK Tour 2027
events.description: Gabrielle’s 1999 #1 album ‘Rise’ was one of the most successful of the era and has been certified 4 x Platinum, a status matched by the compilation ‘Dreams Can Come True, Greatest Hits’. In total, six of her albums have reached the Top 10, including 2018’s ‘Under My Skin’. Gabrielle released her latest and eagerly anticipated album to critical acclaim ‘A Place In Your Heart’ in 2024. One of the UK’s most influential singer-songwriters, Gabrielle has achieved a succession of major awards with highlights including two BRITs, two MOBO Awards and an Ivor Novello Award. After earning a new generation of fans during her show-stealing performances on the 2021 edition of ‘The Masked Singer’, Gabrielle has gone on to perform with some of the biggest artists and had a notable appearance in Stormzy's symbolic music video "Mel Made Me Do It" in 2022. From joining Adele as special guest at her two sold-out BST Hyde Park shows, Gabrielle also supported Lionel Richie and Tom Jones on their huge summer dates in 2024. 2025 saw Gabrielle embark on her biggest ever UK tour ‘The Hits Live ’ which included incredible shows at Manchester’s AO Arena and The O2 arena. 2025 also saw her play outstanding shows across the summer, including Sandringham Estate with Michael Bublé and an amazing set headlining the second stage at Victorious Festival. With a huge catalogue of sing along anthems including, Rise, Out Of Reach, Sunshine, Give Me a Little More Time, When A Woman and of course Dreams and with over 3 decades in the industry Gabrielle is loving being on the road with her band more than ever and continues to captivate audiences of all ages with her performances and songs.

events.title: Russell Howard - Don't Tell the Algorithm
events.description: Following a sold-out 2026 UK and Ireland tour that saw over 200,000 tickets sold, ‘one of the world’s top comedians’ (The Sunday Times), Russell Howard, is inviting you back into the room for his 2027 tour extension: no phones, no distractions, just humans and jokes. Don’t tell the algorithm. “Howard is a megastar” The Times “A comedy King” Evening Standard “Superstar stand-up” Guardian “You’ll not find a slicker, more personable performer the length and breadth of the land” Mail On Sunday “completely irresistible…one of the most effective political stand-ups around. Howard is a brilliantly talented live performer” The Daily Telegraph ★★★★ ★★★★★ Mail On Sunday ★★★★★ Metro ★★★★★ Chortle ★★★★ Evening Standard ★★★★ The Times ★★★★ Time Out ★★★★ The Independent ★★★★ The Telegraph

events.description: Direct from the West End, the Olivier Award nominated smash hit show, The Tiger Who Came to Tea returns on tour. The doorbell rings just as Sophie and her mummy are sitting down to tea. Who could it possibly be? What they certainly don’t expect to see at the door is a big, stripy tiger! Join the tea-guzzling tiger in this delightful family show; packed with oodles of magic, sing-a-long songs and clumsy chaos. Don’t miss this stunning stage adaptation of the classic tale of teatime mayhem... expect to be surprised! A musical play adapted and directed by DAVID WOOD Based on the book by JUDITH KERR ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

events.title: Fireman Sam Live! The Lost Pirate Treasure
events.description: Norman Price is determined to win the Pontypandy Treasure Hunt, but when he discovers clues to a real pirate treasure, he goes exploring deep into the caves. It's up to Fireman Sam, Elvis and Ellie to save the day and find the treasure. With clues, pirate songs and plenty of swashbuckling adventure, Fireman Sam's new live show is perfect for all budding pirates! Live Show Ahoy! Produced by Mark Thompson Productions in partnership with Mattel. Directed by Miranda Larson.

events.title: Legally Blonde - The Musical
events.description: Legally Blonde - The Musical follows the transformation of Elle Woods as she tackles stereotypes and scandal in pursuit of her dreams. This Musical is so much fun it should be illegal! Meet Elle, Paulette, Warner, and many more fabulous characters in this movie-to-musical. Not to be missed!

events.title: Cirque de Danse
events.description: Step into a world where dance meets circus! The Island's leading dance school proudly presents a spectacular fusion of dance, music, and magic! An unforgettable experience suitable for the whole family.

events.title: Amazing Animals
events.description: If you love animals, then you are going to love this show. A show dedicated to and celebrating all creatures great and small. The only show around that you get to see Life sized crocodiles, Sloths, Reindeer, dinosaurs, penguins, Orangutans and maybe even a spraying skunk bursting out onto the stage right before your very eyes. The heart-warming show packed full of music, comedy and amazing animal effects is suited to all ages from toddlers to grownups. Book your family in and come and have a roarsome time. The perfect family show for all ages to enjoy.

events.title: The Good Life - The Service Players
events.description: From the company that brought you Fawlty Towers, Blackadder and Dad's Army, the Service Players take you to 1970s Surbiton in this witty, funny, heart-warming comedy. This recent adaptation of the much-loved sitcom features Tom and Barbara Good, their neighbours Margot and Jerry, some other colourful characters... and a goat and pig or two! 'Couldn't be more timely... cracking comedy... A feel-good psychedelic 70s trip' Broadway World 'Fans will be pleased to hear that some of the funniest of the Goods' adventures are on offer, while new slants recognise the march of time on the ecology front' The Stage 'Funny and warm and feel-good... a slice of pure nostalgia – whether you were a fan of the TV series of not' The Reviews Hub

events.title: Music Legends - The Creative Collective
events.description: Join us for an amazing music and dance variety show taking you on a journey through Rock and Pop! Featuring students from The Rock Project, Unity Dance School, and Mannin Music Rock Choir and string group, this is an event not to be missed! All live music - no backing tracks allowed!

events.title: Come From Away
events.description: 7,000 stranded passengers. One small town. A remarkable true story. Winner of four Olivier Awards, including Best New Musical, and the Tony Award for Best Direction of a Musical, Come From Away is the smash-hit musical based on the incredible true story of a 7000 airline passengers from around the world who were unexpectedly grounded in Canada in the wake of 9/11, and the small Newfoundland town that welcomed them with open hearts. Set in Gander, Newfoundland, the show tells the real-life stories of the locals who opened the homes, community halls, and lives to these "come from aways", forging friendships that would last a lifetime. Told with warmth, humour, and compassion, Come From Away celebrates the very best of humanity at a moment when the world needed it most. Featuring a joyous, folk-inspired score and a fast-paced ensemble cast portraying real people whose lives were forever changed, in a cleverly staged, uplifting and life-affirming musical which is a powerful celebration of hope, kindness, and unity. Two Feathers Production are delighted to welcome back West End and Broadway Director and Choreographer Tara Overfield-Wilkinson, and are proud to bring this extraordinary true story to the Gaiety Theatre stage in a production that will have audiences on their feet night after night. Proudly sponsored by Canaccord Wealth, ATLA Group, Black Grace Cowley, the Isle of Man Steam Packet Company, and supported by Manx Radio

events.title: Cats (Taylorian Productions)
events.description: Taylorian Productions is delighted to present CATS, Andrew Lloyd Webber’s record-breaking musical, this August (05th - 15th August) On one magical night each year, the Jellicle cats gather for the Jellicle Ball, where Old Deuteronomy must choose one cat to ascend to the Heaviside Layer and be reborn. Through a dazzling series of musical numbers, each cat steps into the spotlight to share their story, from the mischievous Rum Tum Tugger (Matt James) and the elegant Victoria (Micha Quayle), to the once-glamorous Grizabella (Kristene Sutcliffe), longing for acceptance and redemption. Featuring unforgettable songs including Memory, spectacular choreography, and a richly imaginative score, CATS is a celebration of individuality, resilience, and belonging. Taylorian Productions brings fresh energy, creativity, and heart to this iconic show, promising an enchanting theatrical experience for audiences of all ages. Join us for an unforgettable journey into the world of the Jellicle cats.

events.title: Jasper Carrott with special guests Strictly ABBA
events.description: With a career that spans decades, the indefatigable Jasper continues to tour and leave audiences breathless with laughter. Rightly known as the godfather of British comedy, he brings to this show his trademark razor-sharp wit and charm. One not to be missed! “...easily the funniest stand-up I’ve ever seen.” Jeremy Clarkson - The Sun “Jasper has this knack of being able to continue –and add to– a sketch so that it gets funnier by the second...” Kevin Gover - Winchester Today Jasper’s special guests, Strictly ABBA, add a touch of pure ABBA entertainment. Featuring all the best-loved ABBA songs, Dancing Queen, Waterloo, The Name of the Game, and many, many more

The Princess Proms
events.description: We invite you to an enchanting concert, singing the most magical music in all of the land. Prepare for a show stopping performance as we pay tribute to the iconic, heart-warming, and nostalgic songs from animations including; Frozen, Wicked, K-Pop Demon Hunters, Moana, The Wizard of Oz, Beauty & The Beast, Anastasia, Pocahontas, Aladdin, The Little Mermaid, The Lion King, Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory, and more! As well as a few from our favourite popstars like Taylor Swift, Coldplay, and Rachel Platten. With an incredible response and sold-out shows across the country, we know this show will stay in your hearts forever. Creating magical memories, sharing stunning musical moments, and spreading joy is at the very heart of what we do. The stars of our show have performed on the West End, ITV, for Royalty, and more, but their dreams have truly come true touring this concert and performing for you. We’re absolutely enchanted to have you join us.

events.title: Dracula - The Service Players
events.description: Dracula, brought to you by the Service Players, is a spellbinding theatrical experience that will plunge you into a gothic world as the dark universe finally arrives on our shores. The play transforms the infamous Count into a mesmerizing stage presence—suave, predatory, and chillingly elegant. As the story unfolds, tension coils tighter with each whispered warning and each sudden appearance of the cape-cloaked vampire, drawing the audience into a battle of wits between mortal courage and immortal power. With its eerie atmosphere, dramatic confrontations, and haunting romance, Dracula on stage is not just a tale of horror—it’s a pulse-quickening spectacle that leaves hearts racing long after the curtain falls. Our Island has waited oceans of time for his arrival!

events.title: Ministry of Science
events.description: MINISTRY OF SCIENCE LIVE - SCIENCE SAVED THE WORLD Direct from London’s West End. Over the last few years Science has led the way in getting our lives back to normal. Now, the UK’s favourite science team are back and more explosive than ever! Join our presenters as they dive deep into the world of science and look at how science shapes the modern world we live in with a few loud bangs along the way! They’ll take an anarchic approach to science communication whilst looking at the scientists, engineers and inventors who have shaped the modern world that we live in whilst proving that each and everyone of you have the ability to change our world for the better! Expect 20ft LIQUID NITROGEN clouds, exploding OXYGEN & HYDROGEN balloons, FIRE TORNADOS, HYDROGEN bottle rockets, ignited METHANE and even a self-built Hovercraft! 100% Educational. 200% Entertaining. 300% Explosive.400% Fun.

events.title: Beauty and the Beast - A Spellbinding Pantomime
events.description: A Spellbinding Tale As Old As Time… You’ve seen the film… You’ve seen the musical… But you’ve never seen it like this… This Christmas, Beauty and the Beast arrives at the Gaiety Theatre… bringing with it a dazzling mix of magic, mischief and magnificent mayhem. Brought to you by Stage-ed - the team behind recent smash-hit pantomimes Cinderella, Aladdin and Dick Whittington, comes a brand-new festive spectacular packed with big laughs, big spectacle and even bigger panto chaos. Join Belle as she sets out to rescue her sister from the mysterious Beast of Peel Castle, where secrets hide behind every enchanted door… But this is panto so... naturally… everything goes slightly off track. Will the wicked Duke of Douglas ruin Belle’s dreams of becoming a true Princess? Will Marigold and her long-suffering son Silly Billy ever perfect their Super Sloppy Soapy Cleaner… or just redecorate the stage with it? Will the Beast remain beastly…? And will true love save the day? Starring a sensational cast - Jolyon Dixon returns for his fourth fabulous year as the outrageous Dame Marigold McGusset (expect wigs… lots of wigs) Stephen Donald is back as the wicked Duke of Douglas (get those boos ready…) Amy Convery returns as Belle - brave, brilliant… and in for a very busy Christmas And not forgetting a fantastic junior ensemble of talented local performers This Christmas, get ready to boo the baddie, cheer the goodie, and laugh until your sides hurt as panto magic returns to the Island. Be Our Guest… Oh Yes You Will!

Of Mice and Men by John Steinbeck
events.description: Steinbeck's own stage version of his classic novel tells the story of George Milton and Lennie Small, the fast-talking farm hand and the simple giant who accompanies him on a lift of casual labour in the California Agriculture Belt of the 1930s. They share a dream of a little place of their own, where Lennie can tend the rabbits and they can "live off the fat of the land". But can that dream survive the harsh realities of the Great Depression, where unstable employment, belligerent superiors, and Lennie's own alarming but unchecked strength are but a few of the obstacles they must overcome.
